description: Transforming Building Structural Resilience through Innovation in Steel Diaphragms is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Benjamin Schafer, Johns Hopkins University (jhu.edu). America relies on a resilient building stock to minimize harm to its citizens and damage to its economy due to extreme natural hazards such as earthquakes and hurricanes. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Steel building, diaphragm, earthquake engineering, bare steel deck, concrete-filled steel deck, diaphragm strength. Published 2021-07-12. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
